messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Different annotations for each facet
parts:
Dear list members,

Is it possible to do different annotations for different facets? I tried the example below but all the annotations appear in both facets.

df = data.frame(
   a = factor(c("Estudio 1", "Estudio 2"), levels = c("Estudio 1", "Estudio 2")),
   grupo = c("Resultados Estadísticamente Significativo", "Resultados Estadísticamente Significativo", "Resultados Estadísticamente No Significativo", "Resultados Estadísticamente No Significativo"),
   b = c(25, 300, 10, 300),
   li = c(10,280, -10, -10),
   ls = c(40, 325, 30, 600))

p = ggplot(df, aes(y=b, x=a, ymin= li, ymax= ls, colour = a))

p +  geom_pointrange(size = 0.8) + coord_flip() + geom_hline(yintercept=0.0) + ylab("Diferencia en tamaño poblacional (Tamaño del Efecto)") + xlab("Estudio") + facet_wrap(~ grupo, scales = "free")  + annotate("text",x=1.9,y=230,label="P=0.02", size = 3) + annotate("text",x=0.95,y=500,label="P=0.04", size = 3) + annotate("text",x=0.95,y=130,label="P=0.15", size = 3) + annotate("text",x=0.95,y=130,label="P=0.09", size = 3) + theme_bw() + opts(legend.position = "none") + scale_colour_manual(values = c("red","blue"))

Best,

Manuel

messages.subject: Re: Different annotations for each facet
parts:
Hi Manuel:

Try this - I separated the text labels into a separate data frame and used geom_text() instead. I may have gotten the coordinates wrong, but there are two labels per graph now.

Starting with your data frame df, create a new data frame that contains the coordinates, label and group ID.  grupo was stolen from df, so the order may be wrong.  I couldn't figure out why you had three text labels at x = 0.95 and one at x = 1.9 (pre-flip) so I'll let you sort that out.

plab <- data.frame(x = c(1.9, rep(0.95, 3)),
                   y = c(230, 500, 130, 130),
   lab = c('P = 0.02', 'P = 0.04', 'P = 0.15', 'P = 0.09'),

grupo = c("Resultados Estadísticamente Significativo",
             "Resultados Estadísticamente Significativo",
             "Resultados Estadísticamente No Significativo",

"Resultados Estadísticamente No Significativo"))
plab$lab <- as.character(plab$lab)    # convert labels to character

# Move aes terms from your object p into geom_pointrange(); otherwise there's a clash with geom_text() later.
p <- ggplot(df)
p + geom_pointrange(aes(y=b, x=a, ymin= li,
                    ymax= ls, colour = a), size = 0.8) +
     coord_flip() + theme_bw() + geom_hline(yintercept=0.0) +

ylab("Diferencia en tamaño poblacional (Tamaño del Efecto)") +
     xlab("Estudio") + facet_wrap(~ grupo, scales = "free")  +
geom_text(data = plab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), size = 3) +
